pairs.question: Esto ager longus pedes mille ducentos, latus pedes CXX. In eo vites disponendae sunt ita, ut quini pedes inter ordines relinquantur. Quaero quot seminibus opus sit, cum quinum pedum spatia inter semina desiderantur?
pairs.answer: Quinquies et vicies duceni quadrageni singuli fiunt sex milia et viginti quinque. Totidem dices opus esse seminibus.
pairs.derivation: Authorial worked-example question explicitly posed with 'Quaero quot seminibus opus sit'. Kept the two preceding sentences ('Esto ager... relinquantur') as verbatim setup so the dimensions and spacing that 'quot seminibus' refers to have a referent. Section marker [2]/[3] stripped. Skipped the non-answering computational preamble (the start of 5.3.2: 'Duco quintam partem longitudinis... Has summas sic multiplicato.') which describes the method but does not state the result; advanced the answer start to the operative result sentence. Answer ends at the verdict 'Totidem dices opus esse seminibus'; the inline section marker [3] between the result and the verdict was stripped, leaving a contiguous span. Capitalization and terminal '?'/'.' normalized.
